blind.description: A stylized wooden spinning wheel featuring a low bench supported by four angled legs with green-painted feet, an integrated foot treadle below, a spoke-and-rim drive wheel mounted on upright posts at one end, and an upright spindle with wound white wool/yarn at the opposite end. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and styled in a clean hand-painted video game asset aesthetic with warm brown wood tones, green accents, and cream-colored fiber.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated wooden bench viewed top-down, with the thin rim of the wheel visible edge-on on the left, a circular white wool bundle topped with a wooden peg on the right, and four splayed feet extending slightly outwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.2 feet tall (around knee/thigh height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet long.
